{{Quote|Those things? It looks like one of those Imperial AT-STs birthed a stunted litter.|Limm Nix's final transmission, joking about the All Terrain Missile Platforms|<ref name="ATMP" />}}
'''Limm Nix''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who fought at the [[Battle of Corrdair]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="ATMP" /> before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''The Force Unleashed II'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the databank have to happen before or in 1 BBY.</ref> against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] bipedal [[All Terrain Missile Platform/Legends|All Terrain Missile Platform]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], also known as AT-MPs. During that confrontation, Nix quipped in what turned out to be the major's final transmission that the All Terrain Missile Platforms looked like the stunted litter of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], another model of bipedal walker. Nix laughed and expressed a lack of concern about the threat posed by the AT-MPs. However, Nix was then surprised by something, and the major's transmission ended abruptly.<ref name="ATMP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Limm Nix was mentioned in the "AT-MP (All Terrain Missile Platform)" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of [[LucasArts]]' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="ATMP" />
